  different input. Do not treat normalized or transformed abundance as counts.
- Use the matched experimental control. Do not replace a vehicle, batch-matched,

/bin/bash -lc "PYTHONPATH=/workspace/.pydeps python - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats

raw = pd.read_csv('inputs/count.csv', index_col='geneID')

def run(samples):
    counts = raw[samples].T
    counts = counts.loc[:, counts.sum(axis=0) > 0]
    condition = ['KL' if s.startswith('KL') else 'WL' for s in samples]
    meta = pd.DataFrame({'condition': pd.Categorical(condition, categories=['WL','KL'])}, index=samples)
    dds = DeseqDataSet(counts=counts, metadata=meta, design='~condition', refit_cooks=True, n_cpus=2, quiet=True)
    dds.deseq2()
    print('variables', list(dds.varm.keys()))
    print('design columns', list(dds.obsm['design_matrix'].columns))
    ds = DeseqStats(dds, contrast=['condition','KL','WL'], alpha=0.05, cooks_filter=True, independent_filter=True, n_cpus=2, quiet=True)
    ds.summary()
    coef = [x for x in dds.obsm['design_matrix'].columns if x "'!= '"'Intercept'][0]
    print('shrink coeff', coef)
    ds.lfc_shrink(coeff=coef)
    res = ds.results_df.copy()
    sig = res[(res.pvalue < .05) & (res.log2FoldChange.abs() > 1) & (res.baseMean > 10)]
    return res, sig

for tag,samples in [('full',['KL1','KL2','KL3','WL1','WL2','WL3']), ('reduced',['KL1','KL2','WL1','WL2'])]:
    res,sig=run(samples)
    print(tag, 'tested',res.pvalue.notna().sum(),'significant',len(sig),'KL_up',sum(sig.log2FoldChange>1),'KL_down',sum(sig.log2FoldChange < -1),'medianLFC',sig.log2FoldChange.median())
    print(sig[['baseMean','log2FoldChange','pvalue','padj']].sort_values('pvalue').head(5).to_string())
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "/workspace/.deseq2env/bin/Rscript - <<'RS'
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(apeglm))
cts <- read.csv('inputs/count.csv', row.names=1, check.names=FALSE)
run_de <- function(samples) {
  m <- as.matrix(cts[, samples, drop=FALSE])
  storage.mode(m) <- 'integer'
  condition <- factor(ifelse(startsWith(samples, 'KL'), 'KL', 'WL'), levels=c('WL','KL'))
  coldata <- data.frame(condition=condition, row.names=samples)
  stopifnot(identical(colnames(m), rownames(coldata)))
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(m, coldata, ~ condition)
  dds <- DESeq(dds, quiet=TRUE)
  cat('resultsNames:', paste(resultsNames(dds), collapse=','), '\\n')
  unshrunk <- results(dds, contrast=c('condition','KL','WL'), alpha=0.05)
  shrunk <- lfcShrink(dds, coef='condition_KL_vs_WL', type='apeglm', res=unshrunk, quiet=TRUE)
  x <- as.data.frame(shrunk)
  sig <- x["'!is.na(x$pvalue) & x$pvalue < 0.05 & !is.na(x$log2FoldChange) & abs(x$log2FoldChange) > 1 & x$baseMean > 10, ]
  c(total=nrow(sig), KL_up=sum(sig$log2FoldChange > 1), KL_down=sum(sig$log2FoldChange < -1), tested=sum(!is.na(x$pvalue)))
}
full <- run_de(c('"'KL1','KL2','KL3','WL1','WL2','WL3'))
reduced <- run_de(c('KL1','KL2','WL1','WL2'))
cat('full', paste(names(full), full, sep='=', collapse=' '), '\\n')
cat('reduced', paste(names(reduced), reduced, sep='=', collapse=' '), '\\n')
cat('difference', reduced[['total']] - full[['total']], '\\n')
cat('DESeq2_version', as.character(packageVersion('DESeq2')), 'apeglm_version', as.character(packageVersion('apeglm')), '\\n')
RS"
